title: Build a Bridge Across a Canyon
instagram_caption:
How do you build a bridge across a 2 km canyon? 🌉

No beam is that long. So: towers, a drone, rope, cables, concrete anchors, steel hangers, and slots that let the wind through. Would you walk across it? Comment below. Tag a friend who would cross first. Follow @StickMindR8
